messages:
elaine-partners: Kicking off a compact onboarding thread for the cloud marketplace pilot. We need concrete artifacts for AWS/GCP/Azure: regional keys, meter mapping, EULA telemetry text, and packaging bundle. Constraints: EU key residency, non-exportable keys, and hourly metering windows.

elaine-partners: Please confirm owners and deliverables: KMS/CMEK/KeyVault samples, metering schema, EULA paragraph with opt-out, and image assets + copy.

nik-infra: I'll build GCP CMEK samples and a small manifest example for the onboarding CLI. Will place service account email in the shared doc: marketplace-onboard@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com

toby-aws-eng: AWS lead here. I'll produce a CFN example that creates regional KMS keys (eu-west-1, us-west-2) with an alias alias/marketplace/redwood and attach a cross-account key policy for the vendor deploy role.

michael-product: Packaging note: I'll create a 1-line, 3 bullet features, and a 200-word long description. Also will produce three screenshot mocks. Prefer SKU format: redwood.standard, redwood.dedicated, redwood.private (trial variants will append .trial).

sara-legal: Draft telemetry clause: "We collect aggregated, non-identifying usage and performance metrics for billing, product quality, and abuse detection. Non-essential telemetry can be disabled from account settings; disabling may affect trial functionality. Logs retained 30 days; aggregated metrics retained 90 days. For EU customers, keys and logs are stored in-region." Feedback?

elaine-partners: Looks good. Two asks: (1) confirm trial caps (14 days, 5K tokens/day, 2 concurrent deployments) and where those are enforced; (2) get vendor metering endpoint/credentials.

nik-infra: We can enforce token caps at the gateway and emit trial usage to the same metering pipeline. I'll add trial_limits to onboarding manifest.

cloud-bot: marketplace-ticket-9001 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MARKET-9001 - assignees: toby-aws-eng, nik-infra, sara-legal, michael-product.

toby-aws-eng: Metering dims we'll push: token_count (per-hour), instance_hours, response_time_ms. AWS expects usage calls within 1 hour of window close; we'll batch/retry.

michael-product: ETA for assets and copy: 48 hours. I'll upload to the shared assets bucket and post link.

elaine-partners: Action tracker summary (owners): toby-aws-eng: AWS KMS + CFN + meter lambda; nik-infra: GCP CMEK + manifest + trial flag; sara-legal: finalize EULA wording and breach notification clause; michael-product: packaging assets + copy; elaine-partners: request vendor metering creds and coordinate vendor call. Aim to have everything in the folder by next Tue. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
